sources.entry: AnyCable - Realtime server for reliable two-way communication over WebSockets, Server-sent events, etc. (Demo, Source Code) MIT Go/Docker

summary.one_liner: AnyCable is an open-source realtime server that handles two-way communication over WebSockets and Server-Sent Events, mainly as a companion to Ruby on Rails apps.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes AnyCable as a realtime server for reliable two-way communication over WebSockets and SSE. This repository holds the open source edition; the README points to separate Pro and managed offerings. Full information is said to live in the external documentation at docs.anycable.io, so the README itself gives little technical detail. It names Evil Martians as the builder and provides a security contact email for vulnerability reports. The README does not describe specific features, APIs, or integrations in detail.
notable: Open source edition with separate Pro and managed offerings
Full documentation hosted externally at docs.anycable.io
caveats: README is brief and defers most details to external documentation
Pro features and managed hosting are separate from this open source edition
